analysis.summary: California Software Company Limited issued its Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26, convening its 34th Annual General Meeting for September 29, 2026. Management detailed ordinary and special business items, including the re-appointment of directors and details regarding remote e-voting and video conferencing facilities. The document covers corporate governance information and administrative instructions for shareholders without addressing operational earnings or financial performance. Management focused its strategy on empowering small and microbusinesses through accessible artificial intelligence (AI) solutions, such as dSpeedUp, dRyZe CRM, dBotMinds, and Zaywoo. The company observed an unprecedented surge in AI adoption among small businesses globally during the financial year 2024-25, with about 68% of small business owners reporting they already use AI.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that there is immense latent demand in the small business segment for technology that is both powerful and practical.
demand_outlook.quote: This growth validated our thesis that there is enormous latent demand in the small business segment for technology that is both powerful and practical.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants.
orders_capacity.quote: dSpeedUp’s digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants, achieving 95% annual client retention as small retailers and service providers embraced the platform’s benefits..

management_commitments.quote: As we look ahead, Calsofts remains committed to building an AI ecosystem that uplifts millions of entrepreneurs, ensuring that innovation is not just for the few, but for the many.
